sentences.text:
This Motor accidents claims appeal having come up for orders on 10.01.2025, the Court on the same day passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024  in  MACA.No.3976 of 2024  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 10th day of January, 2025
ORDER This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 319 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 319 days in Joy P.J vs Sebastian on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36696623/
1 filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
